SketchyResearch & source ↗
A study in paper and light

A world, drawn in pencil.

Surface strokes that reveal new detail as you move closer. Image-space contours with a little life in the line.

How to explore

Drag to orbit the city or sculpture; drag to pan the flat study. Zoom reveals nested strokes. Pencil fit adds subpixel wiggle; Stable fit keeps clean contours. Lines only isolates fitting. Raw shadows and Light only separate visibility from artistic shading.

Hold drawings commits a complete image at up to 10 Hz, without blending. Zoom redraws small stroke variations; orbit, light and traffic keep their seed. Nothing boils when idle. Fast uses two pencil samples; Reference uses four. WebGL2 is required. No external assets or network calls are used by the renderer.
